shortDescription: The central bank of the United Arab Emirates on Wednesday said it would raise the base rate on its Overnight Deposit Facility by 25 basis points to 3.9%, from 3.65%, effective Thursday.The decision followed the U.S. Federal Reserve's move earlier to raise interest rates by 25 basis points.

The decision followed the U.S. Federal Reserve's move earlier to raise interest rates by 25 basis points.
